clips.yt_desc:

A village of 41 people has one well. When six people fall sick at once, everyone blames the dead. Only the water tester knows to check the water.

🧠 Real tip: sickness in many people at once, with no wound, points to bad water. Boil suspect water for at least 1 minute (3 minutes above 2,000 m).

clips.yt_title: The Well Part 2: The Boiling Point | Clean Water Without Fire
clips.yt_desc:
THE WELL · Part 2 of 3 · THE BOILING POINT

The village well is contaminated, but fire means smoke and smoke calls the dead. Nell finds three ways to make water safe and learns who really opened the well.

🧠 Real tips: boil 1 minute, or leave clear PET bottles in full sun for 6 hours (SODIS), or add 8 drops of plain 6% bleach per gallon and wait 30 minutes. For the sick: 1 liter boiled water + 6 teaspoons sugar + half a teaspoon salt. Keep latrines at least 30 m from a well.

▶ Next: Part 3, THE HANDLE. Follow so you do not miss it.

clips.yt_desc:

🧠 Real tips: move latrines 30 m or more from the well, seal the lid, disinfect and pump the well out several times. Wrap and grease noisy handles so the sound does not carry.
